messages:
maria_sales: quick heads-up 1: enterprise prospect requested IAM/access-control artifacts for their vendor risk review (SIG). they want: SAML metadata, proof MFA enforcement, RBAC role export example, and a short least-privilege policy note. timeline = Friday morning. can we assemble?

devin_se: yes. plan: (1) provide SAML XML metadata (redacted certs), (2) screenshot of MFA policy + audit snippet, (3) sanitized roles JSON, (4) one-page least-privilege statement.

anya_infosec: add: a short explanation for machine accounts. we don't require interactive MFA for service principals; instead we enforce scoped API keys, key rotation, and require periodic key reviews. i'll draft that paragraph.

peter_procurement: their security team also asked for an example of role-to-permission mapping (not org-specific). can you include a redacted mapping table or JSON?

devin_se: will include sample mapping. example role export (sanitized):
```json
[
  {"role_id":"role_admin","name":"Administrator","permissions":["org:read","org:write","billing:read"]},
  {"role_id":"role_viewer","name":"Viewer","permissions":["org:read"]}
]
```

anya_infosec: sample SAML metadata snippet (cert removed):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://console.redwood.ai/saml\">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned=\"true\" />
</EntityDescriptor>
```

maria_sales: legal check: do we need an attestation signature? prospect prefers a signed attestation or letter confirming policies.

rachel_legal: yes, we can provide a short attestation. legal needs to sign off on wording. i can review within 24 hours. include a cover note explaining redactions and contact for follow-ups.

devin_se: for MFA evidence we will attach a redacted console screenshot: Settings > Security > MFA enforcement = \"Enabled for all human users\" and an audit log sample:
```
2026-02-18T14:23:02Z - user:alice enabled_mfa true (performed by system)
2026-03-01T09:12:11Z - user:bob changed_role role_admin -> role_ops
```

anya_infosec: on machine accounts paragraph: \"We require scoped API keys with least-privilege scopes, automated rotation every 90 days, and recommend short-lived delegated tokens via our token broker for elevated workflows.\" i'll add references to the docs.

maria_sales: are we delivering as a ZIP to the secure S3 bucket? also need a README mapping each file to SIG questions.

evidence-bot: upload started: s3://redwood-evidence/1780123456-iam-artifacts-v1.zip

devin_se: i will sanitize the role export and write the README linking artifacts to SIG control IDs.

rachel_legal: send attestation draft to me when ready; i'll approve or request edits.

peter_procurement: double-check that SAML XML is machine-readable (they wanted XML file not just screenshot).

devin_se: confirmed 1: we'll attach saml-metadata.xml (certs redacted) and roles.json.

maria_sales: perfect. i'll confirm with the buyer that redacted certs + attestation + machine-readable SAML/roles + README is acceptable. thanks everyone :rocket:
